assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a SINGLE transparent crescent MELEE SLASH EFFECT sprite for a child's crayon side-scrolling game. Image 1 is a MOTION-SHAPE REFERENCE: use only the bright white crescent-shaped close-range sword-swing streak highlighted in its red rectangle, not the sword, people, pixels, level, red box or UI. Image 2 is the DRAWING-STYLE reference: rough handmade crayon/pencil grain and imperfect confident strokes. Draw one bold luminous-looking white and pale icy-blue CRESCENT SWEEP, convex side facing RIGHT and concave opening facing LEFT toward the wielder. Both tips taper to fine points at upper-left and lower-left; thickest and brightest portion at the middle-right. This reads as one instantaneous curved sword-swing trail, a quick broad white blade of motion, not a physical moon blade or a flying projectile. Slight dark slate-blue broken pencil contour so it remains readable on cream paper, pale cyan edge, opaque white center with subtle dry-crayon grain. No central ring or disc, no handle, no sword, no stars, no sparks, no characters, no letters, no background halo, no photorealism, no pixel-art recreation. Entire isolated arc centered with generous margins on a true transparent square canvas; inner empty concavity and outside are transparent. Keep the curve clean and easy to read at small game size, no trailing wisps away from the main slash.
